evidence.title: GitHub - vuestorefront/storefront-ui: A frontend library for React and Vue

name: Storefront UI
summary: Tailwind CSS-based UI library and design system for e-commerce, with Vue and React ports and Figma files.
description: A framework-agnostic UI library and design system for e-commerce built on Tailwind CSS, with ports for Vue (Nuxt) and React (Next). It ships small base components (Button, Checkbox, Modal, Input), copy-pasteable blocks like ProductCard and checkout steps, composables such as useDropdown, a Tailwind preset that maps config to CSS variables, a typography package and a Figma file of the components. Components are WCAG AA compliant.
contains: base components: Button, Checkbox, Modal, Input
Tailwind preset mapping config to CSS variables
